# Contract: `index.json` (schema 1)

Generated at the repository root by `scripts/build_index.py`; committed; read by the website
(`scripts/collect-skills.mjs` in nstarman/nstarman.github.io) from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nstarman/skills/<ref>/index.json` or the contents API.

```json
{
  "$comment": "Generated by scripts/build_index.py from */card.json and registry/*.json. Do not edit.",
  "schema": 1,
  "marketplace": "nstarman-skills",
  "skills": [
    {
      "name": "diataxis",
      "description": "…",
      "origin": "local",
      "href": "https://github.com/nstarman/skills/tree/main/diataxis",
      "source": { "repo": "nstarman/skills", "path": "diataxis", "ref": "main" },
      "install": "diataxis@nstarman-skills",
      "zip": "https://github.com/nstarman/skills/releases/latest/download/diataxis.zip"
    },
    {
      "name": "unxt",
      "description": "…",
      "origin": "external",
      "href": "https://github.com/GalacticDynamics/unxt/tree/main/skills/unxt",
      "source": { "repo": "GalacticDynamics/unxt", "path": "skills/unxt", "ref": "main" },
      "install": "unxt@nstarman-skills",
      "zip": "https://github.com/nstarman/skills/releases/latest/download/unxt.zip"
    }
  ]
}
```

- `skills` sorted by `name`; every field present on every skill; all strings.
- `origin`: `local` | `external`.
- Compatibility: consumers MUST check `schema == 1`. Adding an optional field keeps `schema: 1`;
  removing or renaming a field, or changing a field's meaning, makes it `schema: 2` and is noted in
  AGENTS.md (constitution Principle V).
- The file is pretty-printed (2 spaces) with a trailing newline, so diffs stay readable.

## Website mapping (nstarman.github.io `config/skills.json`)

| `config/skills.json` | from `index.json` |
|---|---|
| `name` | `name` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `href` | `href` |
| `from` (only when `origin == "external"`) | `source.repo` |
